tooling: OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/chat/completions on https://api.longcat.chat/openai and Anthropic-compatible POST /v1/messages on https://api.longcat.chat/anthropic
chaining: pairs with an agent as a 1M-context pay-as-you-go model; the six LongCat-Flash models of the earlier API launch are retired

free_tier.stated: no standing free allowance on the pages read: LongCat-2.0 and LongCat-2.5-Preview are pay-as-you-go from a prepaid balance at a limited-time discount of USD 0.30 per 1M uncached input and USD 1.20 per 1M output. Six LongCat-Flash models were retired effective May 29, 2026. LongCat-2.0-Preview was announced with an initial quota of 5,000,000 Tokens/day, and billing for LongCat-2.0 was announced on 2026-06-30. Promotional credits exist and are consumed before the paid balance, but how a new account obtains one is not stated

limits.value: limits are enforced per API key and exceeding them returns HTTP 429; no requests-per-minute figure is published on the pages read

binding_note: per-key request limit with a 429 response; the prepaid balance is the other gate

identity_cost.detail: outside mainland China an account registers with a mobile phone number or an email. The international-site FAQ states no identity verification is required to recharge or use the service. Mainland China accounts must complete identity verification (real name and ID number) or enterprise verification before recharging or buying token packs

reliability_note: six LongCat-Flash models were retired effective May 29, 2026 and the changelog announces LongCat-2.0 billing on 2026-06-30
confidence_note: pricing and retirement are read from the vendor docs; whether a new-account promotional credit is granted is unverified
